name: fetch_url
description: Fetch the full readable text of a public web page by URL. Use this after a search tool returns a promising result, to read the actual document before citing it — search tools return only short snippets, so a citation based on a snippet alone is not verified. Returns plain text with markup removed. Only public http/https pages are reachable; PDFs and other binary formats are not supported (use s3_text_reader for PDFs in S3).

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the page to read (e.g., 'https://example.org/report')

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text to return (default 20000, which is also the maximum)
